**Bangla Voice Clock** (বাংলা ভয়েস ক্লক) now runs on Linux too.

## New

- **Linux.** The clock lives in the panel (with the time beside the icon on Ubuntu), speaks through PulseAudio or PipeWire, can play through the speakers or headphones you choose, opens at login and shows notifications, like the Mac and Windows versions. Opening it again shows the running clock. It comes as a `.deb` for Ubuntu, Debian and Mint, a Flatpak for any distribution, and a tarball that runs without installing. A Flathub listing is on its way.
- **Open source.** The app is now under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later: free to use, study, share and change, with the credit kept and anything built on it open too. The Classic (1998) voice stays included with permission, outside the GPL (see NOTICE.md).
- **Check for update now.** The button beside the version under General says what it does.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| **macOS** 12 or later | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-macos.dmg`: open it and drag **Bangla Voice Clock** onto **Applications**. It isn't signed yet: the first time, if macOS won't open it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**. Or use Homebrew: `brew install --cask saifulmd0/tap/bangla-voice-clock`. |
| **Windows** 10 or later (64-bit) | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-windows-setup.exe`. SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher: choose **More info → Run anyway**. Or `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-windows-portable.zip`, which runs from any folder. On 0.3.0, the app offers this update itself. |
| **Ubuntu, Debian, Mint** (64-bit) | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-linux-amd64.deb`: open it, or run `sudo apt install ./BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-linux-amd64.deb`. |
| **Any Linux** with Flatpak | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-linux.flatpak`: run `flatpak install --user ./BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-linux.flatpak`. |
| **Any Linux**, no install | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.4.0-linux-x64.tar.gz`: extract it and run `bangla-voice-clock/bangla-voice-clock`. |

On plain GNOME (Fedora, for one), the panel icon needs the [AppIndicator extension](https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/615/appindicator-support/); without it the window stays open instead.

## Known limits

- Builds are not code-signed yet.
- The Linux version is 64-bit Intel/AMD only for now.
